verdict.rationale: Atlas involves signing legal documents such as incorporation documents and SAFEs, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows that documents can be viewed in a Documents tab and that SAFEs can be created, sent and tracked. Nothing documents a tamper-evident audit trail or a completion certificate for signed documents.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
